cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Stay home from the networking dinner. I've finally learned your mother's dumplings. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's coming. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then staying would tell me I'm more than the person keeping dinner warm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Freeze them. We'll have them tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what you said on our anniversary. Call and say you've already got dinner with me.

mechanism: A confidently directs dinner and accommodates its form while pressing B to choose their shared evening over a career opportunity.
confusable: Unlike merely preventing food waste, A rejects freezing as a substitute for choosing the connection; borrowed authority reduces dinner demands to keep B there.
comparison: Repeated anniversary deferral and promotion dinner differ from a ten-minute wedding-vow commitment.
seedUse: Use D82-b dumplings/director/freezing/anniversary and S02-b flexible participation conditions.
